Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met. Responsibilities Key Responsibilities System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: –Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools. –Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems. –Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members. –Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. –Implements performance and load testing. System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: –Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. –Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. –Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. review_candidates.title: Database Platform Engineer - Data License Plus
review_candidates.description: Database Platform Engineer - Data License Plus Location Dublin Business Area Engineering and CTO Ref # 10052916 Description & Requirements Bloomberg's Enterprise Data business builds the technology supply chains that source, model, link and deliver large volumes of financial data for operational, analytical and research workflows, while maintaining transparency, quality and control. Data License Plus (DL+) is a fully managed service that hosts, organises and links Data License content into a unified model and publishes refreshed, ready-to-use data to client cloud platforms. The Infrastructure Platforms team builds the shared services that DL+ engineering depends on and is moving from manual, ticket-based operations towards automated self-service platforms. The Database Platform Engineer will own and evolve the database and search platform layer supporting DL+ and related data workloads. Oracle is the primary accountability: availability, performance, capacity, lifecycle, security, backup and recovery, and the automation that makes those capabilities repeatable. The role also requires credible production experience in at least one adjacent platform: PostgreSQL or a distributed search/indexing technology such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or Solr. This is a platform engineering role, not only an application DBA position; success means turning specialist knowledge into dependable services, standards and self-service tooling. We'll Trust You To Own the Oracle platform lifecycle — set standards for architecture, provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades, capacity, maintenance and decommissioning across on-premise and hybrid environments. Engineer for performance and scale — diagnose and resolve database performance issues across the stack using general database tuning principles (query optimization, indexing) while collaborating with application and infrastructure teams to address root causes at the right layer. Build resilience and recoverability — operate backup, restore, replication, high-availability, failover and disaster-recovery capabilities; define and test RPO and RTO expectations. Automate and enable self-service — use scripting, Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD to replace manual runbooks with safe workflows for provisioning, access, maintenance, validation and recovery. Support adjacent data technologies — contribute to the operation and standardisation of PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or Solr platforms while keeping Oracle as the primary responsibility. Lead migrations and platform change — plan version upgrades, schema moves, database splits or consolidations, data movement and low-risk cutovers with validation and rollback plans. Instrument and secure the service — establish dashboards, alerts, baselines and SLOs, and apply least privilege, secrets, encryption, auditing, vulnerability and patch controls as platform defaults. Improve reliability — support incidents, lead root-cause analysis and problem management, reduce operational toil, and partner with Linux, storage, network, security and application teams. You'll Need To Have Substantial hands-on experience operating Oracle databases in business-critical production environments at platform, database engineering or senior DBA level. Strong Oracle architecture and lifecycle knowledge covering high availability, backup and recovery, patching, upgrades, capacity planning and performance. The ability to diagnose complex Oracle performance problems using database diagnostics and system evidence, then explain the findings clearly. Production experience with at least one adjacent platform: PostgreSQL or Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr or an equivalent search/indexing technology. Strong Linux fundamentals, particularly RHEL, including storage, filesystems, networking, process and memory behaviour, and I/O troubleshooting. Proficiency in Python, Bash or another suitable systems language, with automation experience using Ansible, Terraform or equivalent. Experience with Git-based change control, CI/CD, monitoring, alerting, operational documentation and safe production change. A reliability and customer mindset: incident response, root-cause analysis, recovery testing, continuous improvement and clear communication with engineering teams. We'd Love To See Oracle RAC, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, Enterprise Manager, CDB/PDB architecture, Data Pump, AWR/ASH/ADDM, SQL Tuning PostgreSQL replication and HA, backup and recovery, vacuum and autovacuum, performance tuning. Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or Solr cluster sizing, shard and replica strategy, mappings, ILM, snapshots and search query optimisation. Stateful services on Kubernetes or OpenShift, including operators, persistent storage and workload scheduling. Enterprise storage and database I/O troubleshooting across SAN, NFS, object storage or software-defined storage. Secrets management, cloud data services, and experience in a regulated or audited environment. If indicated, please note that years of experience are a guide; we will consider applications from all candidates who can demonstrate the skills necessary for the role. Whether you're seeking purpose, growth, or a workplace that gives you a true sense of belonging, hear from some of our employees as they share their story about what it's really like to work at HMRC. Visit our YouTube channel to watch the full series and come and discover your potential. HMRC Chief Digital and Information Office (CDIO) is continuing to evolve its platform model, with greater emphasis on platform ownership, lifecycle management and consistent service delivery across complex technology estates. We are looking for an Associate Platform Owner to join Network Services, supporting the ownership and management of network platforms across LAN, WAN, cloud networking and central infrastructure services. This role will support Platform Owners in understanding user needs, managing platform backlogs, shaping roadmap priorities and delivering continuous improvement across Network Services platforms. Working across LAN, WAN, cloud networking and central infrastructure services, the role helps translate demand, service insight and operational feedback into platform improvements that deliver measurable user and business outcomes. You will work with Platform Owners, internal teams and suppliers to help ensure platform improvements are prioritised, planned and delivered in line with user needs, business value, resilience, security and long-term platform strategy. Job Description Network Services provides critical connectivity and network capabilities that support HMRC colleagues, digital services and operational sites across a large and distributed estate. These platforms include LAN, WAN, cloud networking and central network infrastructure services. The Associate Platform Owner supports the effective ownership and ongoing improvement of these platforms. The role helps connect day-to-day operational insight with longer-term platform health, lifecycle management, roadmap planning, risk management and continuous improvement. You will support Platform Owners in developing platform roadmaps, managing backlogs, gathering user insight and helping prioritise platform investment. You will work across engineering, service, architecture and supplier communities to help ensure platform improvements are aligned to business needs, platform strategy and measurable outcomes. Person specification This is a practical associate platform ownership role, suited to someone with strong organisational skills, curiosity about user needs and an interest in developing product-thinking, prioritisation and platform ownership capability across Network Services. Responsibilities Platform ownership support, roadmap and improvement Support Platform Owners in maintaining platform roadmaps and backlogs, helping ensure work is shaped around user needs, business value, resilience, security and service outcomes. Assist with prioritising platform backlog items, lifecycle work, remediation activity and continuous improvement actions using performance insight, demand signals, risks and dependencies. Support the development and maintenance of platform plans and roadmap views, ensuring priorities, risks, dependencies and operational considerations are visible and managed. Help identify opportunities to improve user experience, service quality, operational control and consistency across Network Services platforms. Platform insight, assets and enablement Maintain asset information, inventories, service records and dependency information so Platform Owners can make informed roadmap, lifecycle and prioritisation decisions. Support lab and test environments used to explore platform change, validate improvements and provide evidence for roadmap and backlog decisions. Gather and analyse platform performance measures, user feedback and service insights to identify improvement opportunities and support roadmap decisions. Help improve platform processes, controls and governance so ownership, prioritisation and decision-making are clear across Network Services platforms. Supplier and stakeholder coordination Work with Platform Owners, suppliers and internal teams to coordinate platform backlog activity, improvement work, maintenance and remediation in line with agreed priorities. Support supplier delivery by tracking actions, progress, risks and outcomes against agreed platform priorities, roadmap commitments and service outcomes. Engage with stakeholders to understand user needs, demand, constraints and priorities that inform platform planning and service improvement activity. Communicate clearly, providing accurate information to support prioritisation, trade-off decisions and effective platform ownership. Risk, dependency and operational awareness Support the identification and coordination of issue resolution, remediation activity and preventative improvement actions that inform backlog and roadmap priorities. Maintain awareness of platform risks, dependencies, lifecycle considerations, user impact and operational constraints across services. Support root cause analysis, problem management and change-related activity where required, ensuring learning is captured and considered in platform improvement plans. Contribute to a culture of platform ownership, accountability, product-thinking and continuous improvement across Network Services. Essential Criteria: The successful candidate must be able to clearly demonstrate evidence of the following Essential Criteria: Experience working within an IT, infrastructure or network services environment, supporting platform-based or product-led technology services. Experience supporting platform, product, service or technology improvement initiatives, including planning, prioritisation, backlog management or delivery of change. Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage and track multiple activities, actions, risks and priorities. Experience using performance data, service insight, user feedback, asset information or operational information to inform decisions and support improvement activity. Experience working collaboratively across teams, including with suppliers, internal stakeholders and technical teams. Good communication skills, with the ability to clearly present information and support effective decision-making. A proactive approach to identifying issues, understanding user impact, supporting resolution and contributing to continuous improvement. Desirable Criteria Ideally you will also have experience or understanding of: Network technologies or platforms, such as LAN, WAN, cloud networking or central network infrastructure services. Asset, lifecycle, roadmap or configuration management within an IT platform environment. Lab or test environments used to support platform development, assurance or service activity.
